name: GazeTypeBD: A Synchronized Multimodal Dataset for Error-Resilient Webcam-Based Bilingual Eye Typing.
description: GazeTypeBD is a novel multimodal dataset designed to advance research in gaze based interaction, eye typing systems, and assistive technologies for low resource languages. The dataset captures synchronized data from 41 (+6 repeated participant for second session) participants performing eye typing tasks using a web based interface powered by WebGazer.js. Participants typed 10 common transliterated Bengali words while their gaze trajectories, keystroke events, and screen recordings were recorded simultaneously.
